closed_review_findings.closure: Only accepted and accepted_after_recheck count confirmed closures; dry_run has separate counter. Six status cases plus prior-dry-run/already-flat reset fixture retained.
closed_review_findings.finding: Weekend flatten counted uncertain close statuses as closed.

confirmed_boundaries: Complete open-trades response must explicitly contain a list; malformed/duplicate trade rows and unavailable/disabled rechecks yield unknown.
Explicit trade ID never falls back to another trade. Confirmed open, confirmed closed, and unknown remain separate typed observations.

Full and partial close require exact target identity and signed position-state quantity change. Unknown/mismatched reductions leave actual units empty and cannot authorize FLIP or success deduplication.
Position-state confirmation explicitly does not attribute a broker transaction or fill. The existing accepted status vocabulary is retained with that narrower recorded confirmation scope.

Protective updates require a freshly observed exact trade, matching metadata and tradeable bid/ask quote no older than30seconds; exact transport-rounded stop/trailing values cannot loosen known fixed/guaranteed/trailing protection. Missing trailing level withholds.
Opening gates block unknown when configured recheck is enabled. Compatibility lookup remains a positive-match-only convenience; absence-sensitive new-open callers use the typed blocking predicate.

Sunday/shutdown/campaign callers consume explicit accepted statuses. Weekend closed counts exclude unknown/error/skipped and keep dry-run separate. Local emergency monitor decision labels describe attempted actions, not independently verified close counts.
policy_and_validation_limits: Explicit broker_recheck_before_actions=False preserves the prior new-OPEN configuration policy; this patch does not mandate a new pre-open policy or change advisor SCALE_IN exemptions. It still prevents disabled recheck from confirming close/partial/FLIP or TIGHTEN.
Attempted-pass scheduling, stop thresholds, risk sizing, model predictions and study policies were not tuned or re-evaluated.
No certification of every account-manager strategy, broker fill/slippage, margin/leverage policy or economic performance is made.
All86 tests are owner-executed AST-extracted methods with fake transport plus pure helper tests. Reviewer did not rerun them or read actual account/trade data.
The two account managers and new helper are outside all four active frozen research closures. This review does not activate or authorize them.
review_scope: Bounded read-only source/AST and original fake-transport test review; no manager imports or execution.
